title: A remote erase while the backup prompt or Sync sheet is up raises the questions cover under an open sheet
evidence: From the owner's checkpoint review; predates PR 1602, which kept it. ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift recordChanged (:200-202) checks only the cover and the eraser's hold, not the Offer (:23): when an erase from elsewhere lands (onChange of shownRecord, :120, or eraser.holdLifts, :110), send(.erased) moves the cover from none to the questions (FirstRun.swift:90), whose fullScreenCover (:101) is asked to present while the backup prompt (offer.prompting, :75) or the Sync sheet (offer == .sync, :83) is still up. UIKit may refuse a second modal from a view whose sheet is up, so the cover may not show until the sheet closes; not checked on a device. A fix decides in one place what the Offer does on an erase (close it first, or hold the erase until it closes), with a test. Verify at batch end: a remote erase while the backup prompt or Sync sheet is up. US-25 AC16d
